summary: The US resumed airstrikes on Iran early Thursday, targeting military and strategic facilities across multiple provinces after Iran's missile attack on a US base in Jordan broke a brief diplomatic pause. Iran retaliated with Operation Nasr-2 strikes on the Ali Al-Salem US base in Kuwait, while approximately 20 IRGC/Quds Force advisors were killed in US-Saudi strikes in Iraq. The IDF Chief of Staff stated the campaign across all fronts including Iran has not concluded.
key_points: US launched second wave of airstrikes on Iran early Thursday targeting military and strategic facilities after Iran's missile attack on US base in Jordan, resuming campaign paused 5 days prior for diplomacy. (Source: @VahidOnline/77628)

US strikes hit Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island, Abadan, Kazerun in Fars province, Bushehr, and Khuzestan (Ahvaz), with multiple explosions and smoke reported across these Iranian locations early Thursday. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5918)
IRGC conducted Operation Nasr-2 retaliatory strikes on Ali Al-Salem US base in Kuwait, destroying two drone hangars and one fuel depot. (Source: @presstv/200908)
Iran launched missiles toward Jordan after overnight US strikes; US military intercepted all incoming missiles at the base in Jordan. (Source: @almogboker78/17854)
Approximately 20 IRGC and Quds Force advisors killed in US-Saudi coalition strikes against pro-Iranian militias in Iraq. (Source: @mamlekate/104029)
IDF Chief of Staff stated the campaign across all fronts including Iran has not concluded and Israel is prepared to deepen operations if needed. (Source: @amitsegal/63499)

Hamas in advanced talks to announce disarmament and transfer control of Gaza to an international stabilization force, with a signing ceremony possible in Egypt within days. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5926)
Senior Houthi commander Khalid al-Ayashi killed in US-Saudi strikes against pro-Iranian militias in Iraq the previous night. (Source: @asafroz/52082)

sections.executive_summary: The US resumed airstrikes on Iran early Thursday, targeting military and strategic facilities across multiple provinces after Iran's missile attack on a US base in Jordan broke a brief diplomatic pause. Iran retaliated with Operation Nasr-2 strikes on the Ali Al-Salem US base in Kuwait, while approximately 20 IRGC/Quds Force advisors were killed in US-Saudi strikes in Iraq. The IDF Chief of Staff stated the campaign across all fronts including Iran has not concluded and Israel is prepared to deepen operations if needed.
iran: US airstrikes struck multiple Iranian locations including Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island, Abadan in southern Iran, Kazerun in Fars province, Bushehr, and Ahvaz in Khuzestan province, with explosions and smoke reported across these sites early Thursday morning. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5918)

IRGC announced retaliatory strikes as part of Operation Nasr-2 targeting the Ali Al-Salem US base in Kuwait, destroying two drone hangars and one fuel depot, and pledged continued punishment until American occupiers are expelled from the region. (Source: @presstv/200908)
Iran launched missiles toward Jordan following overnight US strikes on Iranian soil; the US military reported intercepting all incoming missiles at the base in Jordan. (Source: @almogboker78/17854)
A senior IRGC figure, Abu al-Fadl Sepahi, was executed in Imam Ali Square in Isfahan, as confirmed by his mother's interview. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78275)
A hostile drone was downed in the skies above Imam Khomeini port in Khuzestan province, southern Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86385)
Approximately 20 IRGC and Quds Force advisors were killed in US-Saudi coalition strikes targeting pro-Iranian militias in Iraq. (Source: @mamlekate/104029)
Video footage from Ahvaz, Khuzestan province, Iran was captured early Thursday morning confirming strikes in the area. (Source: @shin_persian/8717)
israel: IDF Chief of Staff stated the campaign across all fronts including Iran has not yet concluded and that if needed, Israel will know how to deepen its achievements there as well. (Source: @amitsegal/63499)

IDF Chief of Staff in southern Lebanon stated Israel is ready for any change and a wide range of scenarios, has captured and is clearing areas of terror infrastructure, and will not withdraw until long-term security is guaranteed. (Source: @idf_telegram/24763)

Arab Israeli Amir Yishaam Muhammad Titi from Buqei'a in Galil was accused of spying for Iran, passing information and photos from hospitals, documenting the plaza of hostages in Tel Aviv, protests in Khalisa in Haifa, and a senior security figure's residence in a moshav in Sharon. (Source: @amitsegal/63509)

Dozens of soldiers from Givati Brigade's Tzabar Battalion abandoned their weapons at Field Teman base and left in protest after the battalion commander broke tradition plaques in front of them. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93986)

Several soldiers in the Fighting Pioneer Battalion left their base without commander approval after the battalion commander removed signs related to al-Norm events; the incident is under investigation. (Source: @yediotnews25/133403)

A senior IDF official characterized the Givati Brigade incident as a serious disciplinary event with no place in the IDF, to be treated by commanders with high and uncompromising demands. (Source: @N12chat/219953)
gaza_west_bank: Advanced talks are underway for Hamas to announce disarmament and relinquish control of Gaza to an international stabilization force, with a signing ceremony possible in Egypt within days; weapons would be transferred to a third party, not the Palestinian Authority. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5926)

The Gaza agreement taking shape indicates Hamas will not surrender its weapons but only store them under an agreed mechanism, with understanding from both Hamas and international parties involved in negotiations. (Source: @yediotnews25/133404)

The Arab Israeli spy case involved documentation from the plaza of hostages in Tel Aviv where the suspect held a sign with photos of hostages, as well as footage from a protest in Khalisa in Haifa and a moshav in Sharon. (Source: @amitsegal/63509)

Hezbollah violated the ceasefire last night and struck an IDF engineering vehicle with an explosive drone. (Source: @almogboker78/17851)
Residents near the northern conflict line were advised that they will soon hear explosions from IDF activity in the area. (Source: @almogboker78/17851)

sections.threat_assessment: The resumption of US airstrikes on Iranian soil after a brief diplomatic pause marks a significant escalation, with strikes confirmed across multiple provinces including Khuzestan, Bushehr, Fars, and Hormozgan. Iran's retaliatory missile launch toward Jordan and IRGC strikes on the Ali Al-Salem base in Kuwait indicate a widening regional conflict axis involving direct state-to-state hostilities. The killing of approximately 20 IRGC/Quds Force advisors in Iraq by US-Saudi forces further degrades Iran's proxy network and risks triggering additional asymmetric retaliation. Israel's readiness to deepen operations across all fronts, including Iran, signals potential for further regional expansion beyond the current Gaza and Lebanon axes.
sections.regional_response: Gulf Arab states, particularly Kuwait, are directly targeted by Iranian retaliatory strikes, with the IRGC destroying infrastructure at the Ali Al-Salem base including two drone hangars and a fuel depot. Saudi Arabia coordinated with the US on strikes in Iraq targeting pro-Iranian militias, killing Houthi commander Khalid al-Ayashi and approximately 20 IRGC advisors. The IDF maintains forward defense positions in southern Lebanon and is prepared to expand operations deeper into Lebanese territory. Hamas is reportedly in advanced negotiations to disarm and hand over Gaza to an international force, potentially reshaping the Gaza front. Persian Gulf Arab states are characterized as following US orders without independent regional will.
sections.intelligence_notes: The US two-week attack plan against Iran suggests a sustained campaign rather than a single punitive strike, with Trump stating Iran would be hit 'very hard' and that 'now it is our turn.' Iran's claim that it sought to avoid retaliation after its Jordan base attack was rejected by the US, indicating diplomatic channels have broken down and the pause was ended by Iranian action. The Givati Brigade disciplinary crisis and soldiers abandoning weapons reflect potential morale and cohesion issues within the IDF that could affect operational readiness. The execution of IRGC figure Abu al-Fadl Sepahi in Isfahan indicates internal Iranian tensions that may compound operational challenges. The Starlink activation in Iraq may improve communication capabilities for various actors in the region and should be monitored for tactical implications.
